schedule.rationale: Cutover has slipped twice and the end-of-April deadline is close.

scope.rationale: Scope is stable: the same CRM features are being moved.

quality.rationale: 12% of records fail validation in the trial load.

risk_control.rationale: Risks are known but have no owners or dates yet.

stakeholder_confidence.rationale: The sponsor's date and the support manager's concerns pull in opposite directions, and nobody has decided between them.

risks.description: Schema knowledge is lost when the database administrator leaves.
risks.mitigation: Pair a second engineer with the administrator and record the schema mapping.

risks.description: Bad records stop the final data load.
risks.mitigation: Clean duplicates and country codes before the next trial load.

risks.description: Untrained agents slow down support in the busy season.
risks.mitigation: Run training sessions in the two weeks before cutover.

risks.description: The licence deadline forces cutover before the data and agents are ready.
risks.mitigation: Ask the vendor for a month-by-month licence extension before the decision meeting.

stabilize.goal: Protect the knowledge and data the migration depends on.

actions.description: Start a knowledge handover from the database administrator.
actions.success_signal: A second engineer can explain every mapped table.

actions.description: Classify all failing records by cause.
actions.success_signal: Every failing record has a known cause.

recover.goal: Get the data and the people ready for cutover.

actions.description: Fix duplicates and missing country codes, then rerun the trial load.
Train all agents on the new CRM.

sustain.goal: Cut over safely and keep support running.

actions.description: Cut over with a tested rollback plan.
actions.success_signal: Support runs on the new CRM with no lost tickets.

stakeholder_updates.executive: The CRM migration will miss the end-of-April switch-off. Data quality and untrained agents make an April cutover unsafe in the busy season. We recommend extending the licence by two months and cutting over in June. Decision needed at the next steering meeting.
stakeholder_updates.delivery_team: Our focus for the next two weeks is the schema handover and sorting failing records by cause. New feature requests are on hold until cutover.
stakeholder_updates.customer: We are moving our support system to a new platform. You may see a short change in how we contact you, and we will tell you before it happens.

decision_memo.context: The old CRM licence ends in April, but data quality and training mean a safe cutover before then is unlikely.

options.title: Keep the April date
options.trade_offs: Avoids a licence renewal, but risks bad data and untrained agents at the start of the busy season.

options.title: Extend the licence by two months
options.trade_offs: Costs a renewal, but allows clean data and trained agents before cutover.

decision_memo.recommendation: Extend the licence by two months and cut over in June.
